findings.summary: B44 has no roadmap row, although this repository requires a brief's scope to come from a roadmap row and the row to point to the brief at hand-over.
findings.evidence: .claude/skills/vloop-architect/SKILL.md:15-19 says scope comes from the roadmap and the author must point the row at the brief; docs/design-notes/vloop-roadmap-b18-b21.md:47-48 ends at B41 and contains no B42-B44 row. rg for B44 in docs/design-notes returned no match.
findings.fix: Add B44 to the active roadmap before marking the brief ready, with its brief path, owned self-update scope, and dependency; extend the same roadmap with B43 first if its queue order is intentional.

findings.summary: The binding-reference reasons omit the domain invariants C-2 and C-3 even though the brief amends C-2 and introduces an embedded self-update schema.
findings.evidence: The brief's lines 92-93 cite C-1 and a generic platform description; lines 206-207 define the embedded self-update/v1 schema, and lines 233-238 explicitly amend C-2. docs/domain/domain-model.md:272-276 defines C-2 path rendering and C-3's schema/version/embedding rules. .claude/skills/vloop-architect/SKILL.md:21-25 requires applicable invariants to be cited by ID.
findings.fix: Rewrite the domain binding entries to cite C-2 for the machine-path exception and C-3 for self-update/v1's embedded-schema contract (and retain C-1 only if its precedence is actually needed).

decisions: Keep the command name vloop self-update and leave vloop upgrade as the repository update; I agree.
Use the Go toolchain as the release channel, via go list -m and go install; I agree.
Install only forward by default, with --version allowing any valid explicit version; I agree.
Refuse unsafe cases rather than install to an unobserved location; I agree.
Keep doctor and vloop upgrade offline; I agree.
Report plugin failures without failing the command after the binary step; I agree.
Amend C-2 so this repository-independent command prints external paths with / and the home as ~; operator approval is already asserted by the brief, and the choice is sensible.
Fake go, claude and copilot with temporary Go programs on every test OS; I agree.
Use the existing golang.org/x/mod/semver dependency for comparison; I agree.
Make --check with --version compare and report that explicit target; I agree.
